hero.desc: Immerse yourself in the ultimate Cambodian dining experience, where legendary heritage recipes are proudly brought to life in an atmosphere of refined elegance.

branch.title: Choose Branch
branch.desc: Select your preferred location in Phnom Penh

dateTime.title: Select Date & Time
dateTime.desc: Choose preferred date, meal time & guest size

guestDetails.title: Guest Details & Special Requests
guestDetails.desc: Enter your contact information & special occasion notes

items.a: We recommend smart casual attire. Traditional Khmer attire is also very welcome for special occasions.

items.q: Do you offer vegetarian or vegan options?
items.a: Yes, we have a variety of vegetarian and vegan options available. Please inform your waiter or mention it in the special requests section when booking.

items.q: Is there parking available at the branches?
items.a: Yes, both our Toul Kork and Boeung Kak branches feature spacious, secure parking lots with complimentary valet service.

items.q: Can I bring my own wine?
items.a: Yes, you may bring your own wine. A corkage fee of USD 15 per bottle applies.
To ensure a comfortable dining environment for all guests, pets are only allowed in our outdoor garden areas.
